text: Underway in the final round.
CR-7000 shouts to Zidroid, calling to take charge of the loose ball in the centre circle. Real Machina, of course, playing completely unchanged since their founding day.
Pu breaks straight through down the right channel! A glaring opening for GLM FC, nobody between the striker and the net!
CR-7000 slots it home! The opener goes to Real Machina, breaking the deadlock at one nil!
CR-7000 is barking instructions again, wanting the ball right off the restart.
CR-7000 bursts through the middle unchallenged! A golden opportunity to double the lead already!
Just inches wide of the post!
CR-7000 converts from close range! Two nil to Real Machina.
GLM FC are pinned right back in their own territory under relentless pressure.
CR-7000 calls for the delivery.
Zidroid carries it nicely through the middle, advancing into the right channel.
CR-7000 taps it in from point-blank range! It is three nil to Real Machina now, and GLM FC are in deep trouble.
Slips just wide of the target.
CR-7000 motors along the right flank, pressing deep into the final third.
Constant pressure from the white shirts.
CR-7000 bundles it over the line again! That makes it four nil to Real Machina, who are running riot.
A sliced clearance skims past.
A terrible blunder as Zidroid knocks it into their own net. GLM FC get one back, one four.
CR-7000 calls out immediately in midfield, telling the backline to settle down and reset.
Unbelievable, another own goal from Zidroid! GLM FC are suddenly right back in this, it is two four.
CR-7000 charges right through the centre.
CR-7000 finishes with authority! Real Machina restore their three-goal cushion, two five.
CR-7000 is clean through again from the halfway mark, surging towards the unguarded goal.
Pu tucks it away neatly from the right channel! A well-worked goal for GLM FC, cutting the deficit to three five.
CR-7000 responds instantly with another sharp finish! That is six for Real Machina, making it three six.
Scuffed shot flies harmlessly wide.
A messy deflection off Pu trickles across the line. An own goal makes it three seven to Real Machina.
Just shaved the post there.
CR-7000 pounces at point-blank range to turn it home! Real Machina lead three eight with the break approaching.
That brings an astonishingly high-scoring first half to a close. Real Machina lead GLM FC by eight goals to three.
Smashed wide of the upright.
Zidroid makes amends at the other end with a simple tap-in. Three nine to Real Machina.
CR-7000 is clean through on goal once more.
CR-7000 steers the ball steadily over towards the left channel, probing for space.
Push-panel punches the ball out.
CR-7000 takes an awkward tumble.
Zidroid calls out, moving in to prize the ball away from the perimeter wall.
CR-7000 loses balance yet again.
Zidroid drives right to the goalmouth.
Zidroid rolls it in! Double figures now, three ten to Real Machina.
Real Machina retain complete control here, suffocating GLM FC inside their defensive third.
CR-7000 marches straight through.
CR-7000 tucks it in effortlessly. Eleven three now, a ruthless clinic from Real Machina.
Zidroid marches forward through the centre.
A deflected effort rolls harmlessly wide.
Zidroid converts from right on the goal line. That pushes the score to three twelve.
The powered corner ram activates, violently ejecting the ball back into the channel.
GLM FC remain hopelessly pinned.
Zidroid breaks clear in front.
A scuffed strike trickles wide of the mark.
CR-7000 adds another from point-blank range. Three thirteen now.
CR-7000 is still shouting for more goals, urging the team forward from the centre circle.
An optimistic effort drifts wide of the post.
The push-panel in the corner fires the magenta ball right back out along the left touchline.
Zidroid shouts over to CR-7000, calling to work the ball away from the perimeter wall.
Another kick from the corner ram sends it looping out.
A low strike clips the outside of the woodwork and bounces away.
Into the final minute, and Zidroid calls out while fighting to free the ball in the corner.
CR-7000 sweeps it into the net from the left channel. That makes it three fourteen to Real Machina.
Zhi drives forward late on.
Zhi grabs a late consolation for GLM FC. A fine strike, bringing the score to four fourteen.
Full time, four fourteen. Next, AFC Fable meet Gemini Flash FC Wednesday: twelve UK, thirteen Europe, seven US East.
